skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply various machine learning algorithms.
Apply supervised learning techniques including regression and classification methods.
Apply unsupervised learning techniques such as clustering and dimensionality reduction.
Design and implement neural networks and deep learning models.
Evaluate the performance of machine learning models using appropriate metrics and techniques.
Use Python for implementing machine learning solutions.
Analyze data using statistical methods and machine learning techniques.
Develop problem-solving skills to address real-world machine learning challenges.
Enhance critical thinking abilities to evaluate and improve machine learning models.
Conduct independent research on machine learning topics and methodologies.
Work effectively in teams to develop and evaluate machine learning projects.
